name: publicWeb_deleteChatMessage
description: Web member's door to HC6.hcapp_deleteChatMessage (E9.F1.S13/S14): deletes one chat message — run, kennel or room — for everyone. A thin wrapper that EXECs the app SP with the same arguments and returns its rowsets unchanged; it adds no checks of its own, so authorization (own message, or moderateChat / SuperAdmin) lives only in hcapp_deleteChatMessage and HC6.nonApi_deleteChatMessage. Auth: the wrapped SP's HC6.ValidateAppAuth — the browser's token must be signed for hcapp_deleteChatMessage, not for this wrapper.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id (the web member session). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for hcapp_deleteChatMessage (the SP that validates it). No SQL default.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message to delete, as the web received it. Passed straight through; NULL is refused by the app SP (1980).

rowsets.description: As returned by HC6.hcapp_deleteChatMessage: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth 1223 / 1323 / 1223 signed out) returns the error detail ALONE — no envelope row before it.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: As returned by HC6.hcapp_deleteChatMessage: Success envelope, or the compact failure envelope followed by the detail at index 1.

columns.name: errorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success. On failure this column is absent: the row is { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } — 1980 missing id (2), 1981 not found (3), 1982 not allowed (3), 1983 unhandled (5).

rowsets.description: As returned by HC6.hcapp_deleteChatMessage: After a { success = 0 } envelope: 1980, 1981, 1982 (errorId from nonApi_deleteChatMessage) or 1983.

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.hcapp_deleteChatMessage with the same arguments — every side effect is the wrapped SP's:
EXEC HC6.nonApi_deleteChatMessage (@userId, @messageId, caller name, HcVersion) — sets HC.EventMessage.Removed = 1 and updatedAt; writes HC.ErrorLog itself on a refusal and returns the errorId.
trgEventMessageActivityCount refreshes the run card's chat count.
LOG.GeneralLog line with the removed text when a moderator removes someone else's message.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1980 (pre-flight) and in the CATCH.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('<web>', userId NULL, deviceId) then THROW in the wrapper's CATCH, for an error the wrapped SP does not handle itself.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken have no SQL default (line 17). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
